data.one_liner: GitHub-like contribution heatmap calendar widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a visual representation of contribution data over time using a custom RenderBox for performance. Supports month splitting, custom color scales, touch interactions, and localization.
use_when: You want to display GitHub-style contribution graphs in your Flutter app.
You need high performance when rendering thousands of daily data points.
avoid_when: You need standard charts like bar charts, line graphs, or pie charts instead of a calendar heatmap.
strengths: Custom RenderBox implementation for high rendering performance.
Interactive with tap support and gesture handling.
Fully customizable colors, sizing, and layouts with multiple built-in color schemes.
weaknesses: Only supports English, French, German, and Spanish localization currently.
